subject: QuietWater RFI: SIG questionnaire walkthrough, control mapping & artefact requests
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@quietwaterhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Liu <michael.liu@quietwaterhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: QuietWater RFI - SIG & SOC2 questions (initial)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. Per our procurement team, were starting the RFI run for cloud inference vendors and attached is QuietWaters standard RFI spreadsheet. We have a SIG questionnaire but would like Redwood to complete the mapping (SIG control -> Redwood control), and provide sample artefacts where available (SOC 2 summary, key diagrams, sample logs).

Can we schedule a 30-min walkthrough next week to go over the SIG sections specific to data residency, key management, and access reviews? Preferred times: Tue/Wed mornings PST.

Attachments: QuietWater_RFI_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Sr. Procurement Manager
QuietWater Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@quietwaterhealth.com>, Michael Liu <michael.liu@quietwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuietWater RFI - SIG & SOC2 questions (initial)

Sofia - thanks for the RFI and the time yesterday. We can do a 30-min walkthrough on Wednesday 08/18 9:30am PST or 10:30am PST. Ive looped in Kimberly (security & assurance) to lead the control-mapping portion.

Well prepare a draft SIG -> Redwood control crosswalk and include a SOC 2 summary PDF and a small sample of telemetry logs (redacted). If QuietWater has any high-priority controls we should focus on in the walkthrough, please list them in advance.

Best,
Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: QuietWater RFI - SIG & SOC2 questions (prep)

Kimberly/Priyom/Marissa - forwarding QuietWaters RFI. They want a SIG mapping and sample artefacts. Can you help assemble: (1) SIG control crosswalk (use the attached template), (2) SOC 2 one-page summary, (3) a redacted access/kv-cache sample log and (4) a short diagram of key management flows (redacted). Goal: deliver draft before the Wed walkthrough so Sofia can review.

Priority notes from procurement: emphasis on data residency, KMS/HSM proof, access reviews, and retention. QuietWater is in healthcare so redactions are critical.

Deliverables and owners:
- SIG -> Redwood crosswalk (Priyom)
- SOC2 summary + statement of scope (Kimberly)
- Sample log and retention note (Marissa)
- Drive link + final upload (Ben will collate)

Can you confirm by EOD?

Thanks,
Ben
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: QuietWater RFI - SIG & SOC2 questions (prep)

On Thu, 12 Aug 2026 at 11:02, Ben Carter wrote:
> Kimberly/Priyom/Marissa - forwarding QuietWater's RFI. They want a SIG mapping and sample artefacts.

Confirmed - Ill take the SIG crosswalk. I will: (a) map each SIG control to our existing control names, (b) indicate control owner, evidence type (policy, runbook, config, log sample), and (c) flag any partial coverage or compensating controls. Ill use the QuietWater template and mark fields that need legal/infosec review.

Ill drop an initial draft crosswalk (redwood_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx) to the shared drive by EOD tomorrow and add inline notes where evidence is missing.

- Priyom
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@quietwaterhealth.com>, Michael Liu <michael.liu@quietwaterhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: QuietWater SIG walkthru - draft materials and artefacts

Hi Sofia / Michael,

Attached are the draft materials we discussed for the SIG mapping and RFI intake:
- redwood_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx (SIG->Redwood crosswalk with evidence notes)
- redwood_soc2-summary-2025.pdf (one-page SOC 2 scope & attestation summary)
- sample_kv_cache_access_log_202607.csv (redacted sample showing access events; PII removed)

Quick clarifications:
- Our SOC 2 attestation covers Redwoods hosted API and its operational controls; it excludes customer-managed on-prem private deployments (we detailed scope in the summary).
- KMS key provenance: we can provide KMS flow diagrams during the walkthrough; HSM-backed keys are used for production root signing only (we noted this in the control map).
- Retention: telemetry and access logs default to 90 days in hosted; we listed retention configuration options for dedicated/private in the map.

Please review before the call. If QuietWater needs a signed NDA before we surface deeper artifacts, flag and well loop legal.

Attachments: redwood_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx (xlsx), redwood_soc2-summary-2025.pdf (pdf), sample_kv_cache_access_log_202607.csv (csv)

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Assurance
Redwood Inference
From: Michael Liu <michael.liu@quietwaterhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@quietwaterhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuietWater SIG walkthru - draft materials and artefacts

Thanks Kimberly - quick items before the call tomorrow:
- Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 report includes encryption-at-rest key rotation frequency? If not in the summary, wed like the explicit rotation cadence and proof artifact.
- Wed also like a 1-page diagram showing network segmentation between hosted inference and customer data stores (redacted is fine).
- For the sample log: can you confirm it includes authentication source and IP (redacted) and whether logs are write-once?

Procurement would prefer these items in Drive before the walkthrough. Also sending over a DocuSign link for our mutual NDA (procurement@quietwaterhealth.com).

Mic
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@quietwaterhealth.com>, Michael Liu <michael.liu@quietwaterhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
